title: Databricks Co-Founder on Winning Enterprise Customers
excerpt: A Databricks co-founder shares strategies on how to successfully sell software and services to major enterprise companies.
body_html:
Securing major enterprise clients often depends on leveraging established partnerships rather than relying solely on advanced technology.

According to a co-founder of Databricks, a key strategy for selling to large corporations involves aligning with the sales teams of industry giants.

This approach allows smaller companies to navigate complex corporate sales environments more effectively by utilizing existing distribution channels and market presence.
